strings.subtitle: — Amḥay n ifuyla —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Ajur d uffar ur illa. Sqedc tazmert n wadda.
strings.ssd_warning:
Ɛqel! Ɣ SSD, tarrayt n tira ɣ ufella ur tḥerrez aḥay n TRIM.
Ahil-a i HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Afuyla "{name}" ad yettwari ɣ ufella, ad yettwaḥa.

Kemmel?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS ibriden-nniḍen n isefka (ADS) ur xeddmen.
• Aɣmis USN ur yettwazizdig.
• Tuwqniwin n tili, amidan n usigna
  (OneDrive atg.) ur ttwaxemmen.
strings.status_full: Agbur yettwari ɣ ufella s zeron meṛṛa. Aḥay d awezɣi — Ifecka ẓṛen zeron kan.
strings.status_fast: Aqerru, addaɣ, d tizriyin 4 MB ttwari ɣ ufella. Wiyaḍ ur ttwaxemmen, maca s ttwuri, aḥay tumḍin s ifecka n umsufɣ ur tettwazmir. I isemliyen n tuffra sqedc AČČUṚAN.
strings.status_empty: Afuyla yella d ilem, tira ɣ ufella ur telli. Yettwaḥa.
strings.error_permission: Ur zmireɣ ad ɣreɣ afuyla. Yezmer yella yeldi ɣ ahil-nniḍen. Mdel-t, ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen.
strings.error_not_found: Afuyla ur yettwafen. Yezmer yettwaḥa yakan.
strings.error_is_symlink: Wa d aseɣwen asemday. Iseɣwen ur zmiren ad ttwaḥan — afuyla n uɣawas ad yeqqim d aḥraz.
strings.error_reparse: Wa d afuyla n wemkan (OneDrive niɣ amm). Isefka-s ɣ usigna, mačči ɣ uḍebsi — da ulac walu i uḥay.
strings.error_not_file: Wa mačči d afuyla (takarḍa niɣ wayeḍ). Jur afuyla.
strings.error_hardlinks: Afuyla-a ɣur-s iseɣwan iǧehden-nniḍen ({n} meṛṛa). Iseɣwan iǧehden ur ɣur-sen amezwaru — ismawen meṛṛa d yiwet. Ma tḥa s abrid amiran, isefka ad ttwari ɣ ufella u ad ttwaɣzmen ɣer 32 byte, maca amur ibedd ad yeqqim yezmer ad yekcem s iseɣwan-nniḍen. Ḥa iseɣwan meṛṛa zzat.
strings.error_compressed:
Afuyla yettwadhen, yettwafren niɣ d arqaq. Tira s zeron ur tḥerrez aḥay n isefka iqdim, acku NTFS ɣur-s tarrayt-nniḍen.

Kkes tamerkast: klik ayeffus → Tamerkast → Amussu → kkes tacreḍt ɣ "Dhen" d/niɣ "Ffer". Ɛreḍ SHREDDER tikkelt-nniḍen.
